_comment: Facts about this adapter that its probe response cannot carry: display names, maturity, and the engine versions CI actually restores from. Everything the probe declares (adapter version, engine id, source kinds, pitr) is read from testdata/probe_response.golden instead — never duplicated here. The capabilities generator fails if the source names below do not match the probe exactly, and the integration suite restores from the images listed under verified — the baseline on every run, the rest in the scheduled version matrix and before a release tag — so neither can drift. The official influxdb images idle under command: sleep infinity (their entrypoint execs a non-influxd command directly, measured), so no wrapper image is needed. See docs/capabilities.md and docs/engine-versions.md.
name: InfluxDB

sources.influx_backup_tar: One tar archive (plain or gzip) of an `influx backup` directory, members at the root or under one wrapping directory
sources.influx_backup: One `influx backup` output directory (manifest, KV store, SQL store, shard files); a reused target directory restores its newest backup
sources.influx_backup_dir: A directory of them; the newest by the backups' own timestamp stems is restored
